'''Harrid Norn''' was a pilot and the brother of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader [[Servid Norn]]. In a race against [[Plook Hartar]]'s pilot, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scranton Toon]], his brother placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Toon to ensure Norn would win.<ref name="BtDF" />
